title: Custom Kira Crossbody Bag In Colorblock Signature Canvas

ld.name: Custom Kira Crossbody Bag In Colorblock Signature Canvas
ld.description: Pre-owned and now (re)loved, this Kira Crossbody Bag is a very special Coach custom design inspired by our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet. Saved from the landfill, this gently-worn bag was lovingly repaired and transformed by our in-house craftspeople who added clever details to give it a second life. It’s completely one-of-a-kind, and comes with its own unique set of charms. Wear it, love it, pass it on. Reimagined by Rose Oliva with a sporty Varsity vibe featuring a bold collection of iconic Coach embellishments, this timeless style has been expertly cleaned, conditioned and restored. Our talented craftsperson Fernando Gutierrez hand-decorated the front with eclectic patches and striking pins, repaired the lining, attached a webbing strap, replaced the wristlet with a new one, then added a playful repurposed charm. A total multitasker, our perfectly-sized Kira can be worn as a crossbody, a wristlet, carried as a clutch or used as a pouch in a larger bag. Crafted of refined leather and our Signature canvas, it has two zippered compartments and a convenient center slip pocket to keep you organized with room for a phone, cards, keys and other accessories.
